title: AeroChem: Closed-loop Physics-Informed State Space Modeling for Long-term Chemically-Reactive Air Quality Forecasting--Extended Version
abstract: arXiv:2610.16630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate long-term air quality forecasting is challenging due to long-range transport, meteorological variability, and nonlinear chemical reactions underlying secondary pollutant formation. Purely data-driven models often suffer from long-horizon drift and lack physical consistency, while existing physics-informed approaches commonly follow open-loop designs that fuse neural and physical components only at the output level. We propose AeroChem, a closed-loop physics-informed state space framework for chemically reactive air quality forecasting. AeroChem adopts a two-branch co-correction design: a UDE-based process branch provides a structured but imperfect physical prior, while a Mamba-based virtual measurement branch captures long-range temporal context and produces probabilistic virtual observations. translated_title: AeroChem：面向长期化学反应性空气质量预报的闭环物理信息状态空间建模（扩展版）
translated_abstract: 由于远程传输、气象变化以及二次污染物形成背后的非线性化学反应，准确的长期空气质量预报极具挑战性。纯数据驱动模型往往存在长期预报漂移问题且缺乏物理一致性，而现有的物理信息方法通常采用开环设计，仅在输出层面融合神经与物理组件。我们提出了AeroChem，一个用于化学反应性空气质量预报的闭环物理信息状态空间框架。AeroChem采用双分支协同校正设计：基于UDE的过程分支提供结构化但不完美的物理先验，而基于Mamba的虚拟观测分支捕捉长程时间上下文并生成概率性虚拟观测。神经卡尔曼融合通过在每个预报步骤中校正潜在物理状态并将后验（估计）反馈……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: AeroChem提出了一种闭环物理信息状态空间框架，通过基于UDE的物理过程分支与基于Mamba的虚拟观测分支的双分支协同校正设计，实现了长期化学反应性空气质量的高精度预报。
en_tdlr: AeroChem introduces a closed-loop physics-informed state space framework with a two-branch co-correction design (UDE-based physical process branch and Mamba-based virtual measurement branch) for accurate long-term chemically-reactive air quality forecasting.
